name: ai-setup
description: Personal Claude Code setup mirrored from OpenCode global configuration.

plugins.name: repo-docs
plugins.description: Local semantic doc search, installed-package lookup and JS/TS file-impact tools for one repository. dev-core requires it.

plugins.name: dev-core
plugins.description: The always-on engineering rules, core skills, and the tier and domain specialist agents. Requires the repo-docs plugin for repo grounding.

plugins.name: concise-output
plugins.description: Always-on rules for how output reads: short and plain in anything a person sees, and only what was asked for in anything that leaves the machine.

plugins.name: rules-index
plugins.description: SessionStart reminder listing every .claude/rules and ~/.claude/rules file with its name, description, and paths, so path-scoped rules are known before a matching file is read.

plugins.name: better-design
plugins.description: Vendored web design, motion, and 3D skills from MengTo/Skills, GreenSock, Emil Kowalski, ibelick, and Vercel's web interface guidelines. Skills only; no rules, hooks, or MCP servers.

plugins.name: fundamentals
plugins.description: One skill, building-blocks: explains what is going on, what was built, or the answer to a question in plain words, for someone who was not in the session. For end-of-session handoffs that are actually readable.

plugins.name: verified
plugins.description: Stop-hook correctness gate: scores an answer's factual claims against what the session actually ran, blocks on anything unbacked, and records verdicts to a replay ledger so pattern changes are scored before they ship.

plugins.name: feedback
plugins.description: Local feedback inbox MCP for the AI setup: collect_feedback records bugs, pain points, ambiguities, and ideas; read_feedback lists them so they can be acted on later. Stored as JSONL inside the plugin.

plugins.name: scope
plugins.description: Stop-hook scope note: snapshots the working tree at each prompt, diffs it when the answer stops, and shows which changed files neither the request nor the answer names, skipping lockfiles and version bumps.

plugins.name: journal
plugins.description: Per-turn change journal written by hooks: one on-device-model line per changed file, shown at the next session start and handed to an optional issue-tracker sink.

plugins.name: quiet-tools
plugins.description: Shows each tool call as one dim line and hides its output, so the agent's text stands out. ctrl+o still shows everything.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Step through the file edits Claude made in the last turn, one diff at a time (/replay, or r after a turn).
